subject: modified small inputs for xxh3
perf_evidence: Commit message: 'in order to pass the new Perlin_noise test. Sizes 4-8 should also be slightly faster.' (XXH3_len_4to8_64b now uses one 64x64 multiply by PRIME64_2 instead of PRIME32_1 multiply + extra multiply in the final mix).
change_summary: Pre-v0.8.0 XXH3 output change: new XXH3_len_4to8_64b mixing (inputs swapped, shift 39, multiply by PRIME64_2, no pre-avalanche multiply), new avalanche constant, reordered 1to3 combination, seed removed from 9to16 low lane, len==0 now hashes the secret (64b and 128b).

notes: Intentional pre-v0.8.0 hash-formula change (XXH3 output frozen only at v0.8.0, 2020-07-27). Flags: -O3 -march=x86-64-v3 -fno-strict-aliasing -fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -w -DXXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 -mllvm -inline-threshold=100000 -mllvm -inline-cold-callsite-threshold=100000 (the cold-callsite threshold is needed: XXH_likely/__builtin_expect branch weights make some call sites 'cold' (threshold 45) so e.g. XXH3_len_4to8_64b stayed out of line and both sides only compared calls to it -> fake 'correct'; xx_notes.json shows no residual calls in any target). Runner c/xxHash/_work2020/xx_alive.py, --smt-to 300000. Raw targets pass input (16 B) and secret (64 B) as noundef scalar args copied into fresh local buffers (no aliasing/poison). Api targets: input pointer + symbolic len bounded to the length class, seed symbolic; _withSecret targets take a secret pointer with secretSize>=136. Counterexample search on raw needed concrete len/secret (r_rawcex); fully symbolic raw timed out (r_raw, UNKNOWN). Native sanity (native_x86_64/): old vs new XXH3 outputs differ for every length 0..256 (avalanche constant changed), XXH32/XXH64 unchanged.
